propos: The same rule everywhere: a 20 px pictogram, a word, a colour.
regle: The meaning of the colours never moves — green: it holds · cyan: it has changed · red: it no longer holds · purple: it comes from the network · dark yellow: attention, restricted · grey: past or neutral.
compte: All {nombre} states of the system are shown here, light and dark side by side. The last family gathers those the mock-up does not file: a state with no showcase is a state nobody checks.
sens-propos: A state carries no colour of its own: it refers to the role that carries it. Adding a state therefore never creates one more hue.

sens-de.succes: It holds — confirmed, up to date, in progress
sens-de.information: It has changed — moved, sent, under review
sens-de.danger: It no longer holds — cancelled, outdated, unreadable
sens-de.reseau: It comes from the network — reported, not yet official
sens-de.attention: Attention, restricted — what concerns the person right now
sens-de.terminee: Past or neutral — closed, not retained, full
